score_formula: v5 (2026-07-29): four weighted parts, each normalised across the cohort. (1) activity 0.40 - papers are grouped into three-day windows; each window scores 16 * 0.5^(age_days/60) * sqrt(sum of per-paper depth), so ten pieces dumped on one day do not stack ten-fold over ten pieces spread across months; depth = page-declared <meta name="sde:paper-weight"> when present, else 1.0 for poems, else clamp(sqrt(words/10000), 0.6, 1.8); plus min(20, 4*distinct months). (2) number of published pieces 0.20, as sqrt(count). (3) innovation 0.25 - mean of blind SDE innovation scores only (papers[].iq where iq_kind=='blind'), mapped to 0-100 over 125-150. (4) disciplinary breadth 0.15 - the effective number of primary fields, exp(Shannon entropy) over papers[].field. Entropy rather than a label count: fifty pieces spread evenly over four fields are broader than seventy concentrated in one field that happen to carry forty-nine self-invented labels. Parts (3) and (4) are shrunk toward the site-wide mean with K=10 so a four-paper sample cannot speak for seventy-three; students with no data take the mean and are neither penalised nor rewarded. Total length was trialled as a fifth part and removed: it correlates with the piece count at r=0.985 and only double-counts volume. papers[].iq, iq_kind and field are all derived from the article pages by tools/build_roster.py, never hand-written: roster.json is rebuilt from disk on every content push, so hand-added fields are overwritten. NOTE (2026-08-07): students[].count is now the WEIGHTED piece count - a monograph counts as ten papers via its page-declared sde:paper-weight; students[].items holds the raw number of pages. 2026-08-15 ruling: companion pieces (<slug>/interpretation and <slug>/practice, written by the SDE editorial desk) DO count as student works — they are included in items, count and the activity term, with depth 1.0 unless the page declares a weight. The works-page panels were reworded to match. 2026-08-16 ruling supersedes the depth part: a companion read is worth HALF A PAPER. Both layouts count — the sub-directory form (<slug>/interpretation, <slug>/practice) and the same-directory form (<slug>/explain.html, <slug>/practice.html, 166 pages that the roster never saw before) — each is one item, but carries weight 0.5, so it contributes half to count and half to the activity depth. Rationale: companions are written by the editorial desk and hang off a parent paper; at full weight "who got companions written" would outrank "who wrote what" (companion share ran from 0% to 53% across students).
